provenance.method: exact Z[omega_3] 1-pivot Galois quotient scan over the 173 symmetry orbit representatives of D_3

llm.role: we* multi-agent algebraic quotient and exact certificate synthesis

notes: Upgrades T3-m3-lower-6 from reproduced (where candidate lines were harvested on a random C^6 projection with a floating-point parallelism margin) to verified (exact: true, 2.6 s on one core). Over Z[omega_3], the 3D Gal(Q(omega_9)/Q(omega_3))-invariant subspace V_3(T3) is spanned by three disjoint-support monomial vectors u_0, u_1, u_2 in Z[omega_3]^27 with u_r[r] = 1, so the first quotient Z[omega_3]^27 / span(u_0, u_1, u_2) = Z[omega_3]^24 is exact with no division. Scanning the 173 symmetry pivot orbit representatives of |T3>^3 by exact projective ray canonicalisation in Z[omega_3]^24 harvests the single candidate 5-state orbit {351, 352, 6912, 7029, 7146} of bucket size >= 4 with zero random projections and zero floating-point margins, and exact Q(omega_3)-rank over Z confirms those 5 states have rank 3 while adjoining V_3(T3) gives rank 5 > 3.
